# nuthatch nest on arc-testnet

A self-hosted blockchain index. Query it locally; there is no third-party API.

## Contracts
- `intent_router` = 0x69946ffbbe5f250c7357b89e4072f9eafc1c3ee6
- `vault_factory` = 0xd458d83c874296ec4a29c47655ae47302879b23a
- `settlement_receiver` = 0x8b93b54d6df61e9422d14c309f3c9ab950b920cd
- `settlement_receiver_2` = 0xa60c586e4d050233885cd6628b7c1a217574d9c6

## Tables (one per contract event)
- `intent_router__destination_configured` - DestinationConfigured(uint256,address) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, chainId, receiver)
- `intent_router__in_flight_released` - InFlightReleased(bytes32,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, intentId, amount)
- `intent_router__intent_created` - IntentCreated(bytes32,address,address,uint8,address,uint256,uint256,uint256,uint16,uint64,uint256,address,uint256,bytes32) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, intentId, sender, recipient, intentVersion, inputToken, amount, sourceChainId, destinationChainId, maxFeeBps, deadline, nonce, tokenOut, targetMinOut, settlementRef)
- `intent_router__limits_configured` - LimitsConfigured(uint256,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, maxIntentAmount, maxInFlightValue)
- `intent_router__owner_transferred` - OwnerTransferred(address,address) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, previousOwner, newOwner)
- `intent_router__paused_set` - PausedSet(bool) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, paused)
- `intent_router__router_initialized` - RouterInitialized(address,address,address) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, owner, settlementAsset, settlementInitiator)
- `intent_router__trade_intents_allowed_set` - TradeIntentsAllowedSet(bool) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, allowed)
- `liquidity_vault__delivered_via_swap` - DeliveredViaSwap(bytes32,address,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, intentId, tokenOut, amountOut)
- `liquidity_vault__deposit` - Deposit(address,address,uint256,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, caller, receiver, assets, shares)
- `liquidity_vault__fast_filled` - FastFilled(bytes32,address,address,uint256,uint256,uint256,uint16) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, intentId, recipient, signer, inputAmount, outputAmount, feeAmount, feeBps)
- `liquidity_vault__fee_policy_configured` - FeePolicyConfigured((uint16,uint16,uint16,uint16,uint16,uint16,uint16)) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, policy)
- `liquidity_vault__fees_accrued` - FeesAccrued(bytes32,uint256,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, intentId, toProtocol, toLps)
- `liquidity_vault__fill_limits_configured` - FillLimitsConfigured(uint16,uint16) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, maxFillBps, maxExposureBps)
- `liquidity_vault__paused_set` - PausedSet(bool) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, paused)
- `liquidity_vault__reimbursement_recorded` - ReimbursementRecorded(bytes32,uint256,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, intentId, amountReceived, exposureCleared)
- `liquidity_vault__reserve_floor_configured` - ReserveFloorConfigured(uint16) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, reserveFloorBps)
- `liquidity_vault__swap_fell_back` - SwapFellBack(bytes32,address,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, intentId, tokenOut, usdcDelivered)
- `liquidity_vault__vault_initialized` - VaultInitialized(address,address,uint16) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, owner, asset, reserveFloorBps)
- `liquidity_vault__withdraw` - Withdraw(address,address,address,uint256,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, caller, receiver, shareOwner, assets, shares)
- `settlement_receiver_2__held_for_vault` - HeldForVault(bytes32,address,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, intentId, vault, amount)
- `settlement_receiver_2__lp_reimbursed` - LpReimbursed(bytes32,address,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, intentId, vault, amount)

- `settlement_receiver__held_for_vault` - HeldForVault(bytes32,address,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, intentId, vault, amount)
- `settlement_receiver__lp_reimbursed` - LpReimbursed(bytes32,address,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, intentId, vault, amount)
- `settlement_receiver__receiver_initialized` - ReceiverInitialized(address,address,address,address) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, owner, asset, market, messageTransmitter)
- `settlement_receiver__recipient_paid_by_fallback` - RecipientPaidByFallback(bytes32,address,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, intentId, recipient, amount)
- `settlement_receiver__reporter_set` - ReporterSet(address,bool) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, reporter, allowed)
- `settlement_receiver__settled_with_proof` - SettledWithProof(bytes32,uint8,uint256,bytes32) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, intentId, outcome, amount, cctpNonce)
- `vault_factory__factory_initialized` - FactoryInitialized(address,address,address,address) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, owner, asset, market, settlementReceiver)
- `vault_factory__owner_transferred` - OwnerTransferred(address,address) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, previousOwner, newOwner)
- `vault_factory__vault_created` - VaultCreated(address,address,string,(uint16,uint16,uint16,uint16,uint16,uint16,uint16),uint16,uint16,uint16) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, vault, owner, label, policy, reserveFloorBps, maxFillBps, maxExposureBps)

## Live HTTP API (run `nuthatch dev`)
- `GET /`                    index status
- `GET /tables`              every table with its columns
- `GET /table/{name}?limit=N` recent rows of one table (hot + sealed)
- `GET /entity/{id}`         one row by id (`{block:012}-{logindex:06}`)
- `GET /sql?q=SELECT...`     read-only SQL; each table is a view named `{alias}__{event}`
- `GET /balances?limit=N`    top holder balances (when an ERC-20 Transfer table is present)
- `GET /balance/{address}`   one address's derived balance

## MCP (for coding agents)
Run `nuthatch mcp` (stdio) to expose tools: status, schema, tables, table, sql, entity,
balance, top_balances. Fully offline against the local instance; nothing phones home.
